  • Methodendetails

    • setAuthToken

      public static void setAuthToken(String authToken)
      Set the auth token. This can only be called once and cannot be used again, except when unsetAuthToken() method has been called.

      The auth token is required for creating RequestDest.LOCAL, RequestDest.PD, RequestDest.GLZ, and RequestDest.SHARED requests.

      Parameter:
      authToken - Auth token.

    • unsetAuthToken

      public static void unsetAuthToken()
      Unsets the auth token, in case it has been set already.

    • isAuthTokenSet

      public static boolean isAuthTokenSet()
      If the auth token has been set already.
      Gibt zurück:
      True if the auth token is set. False otherwise.

    • setHeaders

      public static void setHeaders(String accessToken, String entitlementToken, String currentVersion)
      Set the headers. This can only be called once and cannot be used again, since the access token has been set.

      Access token must be unset first using the unsetHeaders() method in order for it to be set again.

      The headers are required for creating RequestDest.PD, RequestDest.GLZ, and RequestDest.SHARED requests.

      Parameter:
      accessToken - Access token.
      entitlementToken - Entitlement token.
      currentVersion - Version.

    • unsetHeaders

      public static void unsetHeaders()
      Unsets all the headers. Can only be done when they are all set.

    • areHeadersSet

      Gibt zurück:
      True if all headers are set. False otherwise.
